seed_scope: Controller draws; original RNG uncontrolled. Each pair uses same original physical host; rank, menus, character, capture and start inventory match.
per_decision: 96x112 grayscale and abs difference; 4 categorical heads; ordinary game physical keys, no assist; 120 ms target.
endpoint: Full credit, first original Continue or clear, zero Continue accepted.

optimizer.objective: Joint 4-head clipped PPO from same trained parent actor and critic
optimizer.reward: -1 per stable confirmed spare loss incl final fatal when native Continue seen. +0.002 per playable 120 ms decision. Unconfirmed spell presses and native score receive no reward.

budget: One four-credit TRAIN increment, two fresh held pairs, monitor 15-minute first-increment physical budget; previously reported qualification credit excluded.
